thread:
alex: Heads-up — new org/project for customer pilot 'Orpheus' needs cross-cloud GPU quotas and networking preflight. I started a checklist, attaching key asks below. Can folks validate?

maria: thanks. which regions + instance types?

alex: primary regions: us-west-2 (AWS), europe-west1 (GCP), westeurope (Azure). GPUs: p4d and g5 (AWS), a2-highgpu-1g (GCP), NVidia A10/A100 SKU on Azure. Also need spot/low-priority quotas for burst testing.

devon: adding note: we should request increased ENI and subnet IP limits in aws us-west-2 — we've hit that before when provisioning many GPU nodes.

infra-bot: :information_source: Template for cloud quota request posted: https://intra.example.com/runbooks/quota-requests

sre_jen: Alex — include expected steady-state and burst numbers, and duration for burst. Support teams ask for concrete numbers to expedite.

alex: Good point. Draft numbers: steady-state 8 GPUs per region, burst to 32 for 48 hours during soak test. Budget approval for burst is pending (cc: @maria).

maria: budget approved for pilot up to $12k/mo. Burst spend needs separate sign-off — prefer to use spot/low-priority for burst to limit cost.

devon: For GCP, open ticket text I usually use: "Please increase GPU quota in europe-west1 to X A100 (or a2) and allow preemptible instances. Project: proj-orpheus, billing account: bill-123." Should we copy that?

alex: yes — please draft and I'll file. Also need IAM roles: infra-deployers, infra-readonly, and cost-admin. Terraform service account must have Compute Admin + Billing User on GCP, EC2 FullAccess-ish on AWS, and Contributor + Billing Reader on Azure.

sre_jen: Put a least-privilege spin: we can create scoped roles for just compute and quota request actions. For AWS, attach: AmazonEC2FullAccess for the provisioning SA, and a separate billing role for cost runs. For GCP limit the SA scope to compute and serviceusage.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Checklist item created: /checklists/orpheus-account-preflight — ID #CL-8821

alex: I'm pasting the repo snippets for the support tickets — feel free to copy/paste and edit.

alex: ```
AWS support request (us-west-2):
Subject: Increase EC2 GPU capacity and ENI/subnet IP limits for proj-orpheus
Body: Hi team, we are launching a pilot (proj-orpheus). Requested increases:
- RunInstances limit (p4d, g5): 32 -> 128
- Elastic Network Interfaces (ENI) quota: 1000 -> 4000
- VPC subnet ip addresses soft limit per AZ: 250 -> 1000
Project tags: env:pilot, team:inference, cost-center:ORP-42
Billing account: bill-123
Estimated timeframe: steady 8 GPUs, 48h bursts to 32 GPUs.
Thanks, Alex
```

maria: Looks good — add "preferred AZ spread: b/c/d" so infra can avoid single-AZ limits.

devon: For Azure, open support request must reference subscription ID and quota class. Example body: "Increase NCv3/ND A100 quota in westeurope to 32 dedicated + allow low-priority scaling to 64 for test window."

alex: Also flagged: GCP has regional quota for GPUs that sometimes blocks cross-zone provisioning. Add a request for: "Per-region GPU quota: 32 -> 128; allow preemptible a2 family."

sre_jen: Networking checklist: dedicated VPCs per environment, shared firewall rules managed via tf modules, and limit control plane egress to our logging endpoints. Also: request increase for Cloud NAT ephemeral ports for egress burst.

alex: Tagging policy: all instances and disks must include tags: team, project, env, cost-center, owner. We'll enforce with a pre-provision policy hook in the terraform module.

maria: Who's owning the quota tickets? Devon can you file AWS + Azure? I'll do GCP (I have the billing pairing).

devon: I can file AWS + Azure today. Will paste ticket IDs here once created.

infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: previous quota request in us-west-2 took 36h to approve last time. Consider submitting early.

alex: Good to know — starting now. Devon can you include the expected time window and justify burst duration to speed it up?

devon: Filing AWS request now. Draft ID: AWS-92741 (will update).

maria: GCP ticket opened: GCP-55812. Requested a2 preemptible + regional increase.

sre_jen: Also request service quota increases for Cloud Load Balancers and forwarding rules if you plan to expose endpoints. They occasionally require separate approvals per region.

alex: Noted — for pilot we'll use internal-only LB, but still request quota bump to avoid surprises.

devon: AWS support reply: need justification for ENI increase — added note about short-lived burst and AZ spread. Also asked for VPC ID and subnet IDs. Posted ticket link: https://aws.support/console/cases/AWS-92741

maria: For tagging enforcement, I'll add a pre-commit check in our infra repo that rejects deployments without the tags. Will open PR and ping @devon for review.

sre_jen: Cost control: enable budget alerts at 50%/75%/90% for prod and pilot. For burst we'll add a temporary budget with threshold alert to paging on-call if exceeded.

alex: final checklist we want to close today: 1) file all quota tickets (AWS, GCP, Azure) 2) create IAM service accounts with scoped roles 3) subnet IP/ENI increases requested 4) tagging policy PR + preflight hook 5) budget alerts configured 6) Slack alert channel for provisioning ops.

devon: Filing Azure now — ticket AZ-33009 created.

maria: PR for tagging enforcement: https://git.internal/infra/pull/420 — reviewers: @devon, @sre_jen

alex: thanks all — once all ticket IDs are in I'll add them to CL-8821 and we can schedule the provisioning window. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: Checklist CL-8821 updated with ticket refs: AWS-92741, GCP-55812, AZ-33009

sre_jen: Nice. We'll plan a dry-run with 8 GPUs per region next week and a staged burst test after quota approvals.

maria: ping me when dry-run scheduled so I can approve any incremental budget.

alex: Will do — closing thread for now, reopen if blockers show up. :wave:
